questions.prompt: A Storage object has level initially 0 and nonnegative capacity. Write update_storage_level(storage, changes) to examine each integer change in order. Apply a change ONLY if level + change is within [0, capacity]; otherwise reject that individual change and leave level as it was. Continue to process later changes. Return final storage.level and leave capacity unchanged. Empty changes returns 0. NOTE: This task rejects invalid changes; it does not clamp values.

grading.return_contract: Check numeric/string return or ordered object fields, object identity, and input non-mutation where applicable.

questions.title: Explain Bounded Score Changes

Explain in four short numbered parts: (1) which attribute changes and what is returned; (2) stored score after every change; (3) why bounds are checked after each individual change; (4) whether -2 is applied after the goal is reached and what happens for empty changes. Answer using four short numbered parts; equivalent correct explanations receive credit.
